text_block_list.text:
One day, Tazuna-san dropped by the 
Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you so, so much for your 
hard work!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Only a handful of Umamusume in this 
academy make it through these three years 
unscathed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Being able to watch over all of you like 
this the entire time... has made me so 
happy♪
choice_data_list:
Likewise, thank you very much for watching 
over us.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you and your trainee 
care to join us after this?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Today—let's buy three portions of apples 
first!

And so, Tazuna-san, <chrname>, and I enjoyed ramen 
and gyoza together.
